answer: The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the pulse of a task receipt, and the pearl is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
